query:
SELECT u.id, u.openId, u.name, u.email, u.role, d.id as dealerId, d.name as dealerName, d.isVerified
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN dealers d ON u.id = d.userId
WHERE u.email = 'anthony.m.perry@gmail.com';
